1.english_reference: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּקָּבְצ֧וּ כָֽל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶל דָּוִ֖יד חֶבְר֣וֹנָ ה
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἦλθεν πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς Δαυεὶδ ἐν Χεβρὼν
traditions.VUL: Congregátus est ígitur omnis Israel ad David in Hebron ,
traditions.KJV: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron ,

traditions.WLC: לֵ אמֹ֑ר
traditions.LXX: λέγοντες
traditions.KJV: saying ,

1.english_reference: Behold , we [ are ] thy bone and thy flesh .

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּ֛ה עַצְמְ ךָ֥ וּֽ בְשָׂרְ ךָ֖ אֲנָֽחְנוּ
traditions.LXX: Ἰδοὺ ὀστᾶ σου καὶ σάρκες σου ἡμεῖς ·
traditions.VUL: Os tuum sumus , et caro tua .
traditions.KJV: Behold , we [ are ] thy bone and thy flesh .

2.english_reference: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel

traditions.WLC: גַּם תְּמ֣וֹל גַּם שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם גַּ֚ם בִּ הְי֣וֹת שָׁא֣וּל מֶ֔לֶךְ אַתָּ֛ה הַ מּוֹצִ֥יא וְ הַ מֵּבִ֖יא אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ὄντος Σαοὺλ βασιλέως σὺ ἦσθα ὁ ἐξάγων καὶ εἰσάγων τὸν Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: Heri quoque , et nudiustértius cum adhuc regnáret Saul , tu eras qui educébas , et introducébas Israel :
traditions.KJV: And moreover in time past , even when Saul was king , thou [ wast ] he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel :

2.english_reference: and the LORD thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜י ךָ לְ ךָ֗ אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת עַמִּ י֙ אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Ἰσραήλ Κύριός σοι Σὺ ποιμανεῖς τὸν λαόν μου τὸν Ἰσραήλ ,
traditions.VUL: tibi enim dixit Dóminus Deus tuus : Tu pasces pópulum meum Israel ,
traditions.KJV: and the LORD thy God said unto thee , Thou shalt feed my people Israel ,

2.english_reference: and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel

traditions.WLC: וְ אַתָּה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה נָגִ֔יד עַ֖ל עַמִּ֥ י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ σὺ ἔσῃ εἰς ἡγούμενον ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: et tu eris princeps super eum .
traditions.KJV: and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel .

3.english_reference: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron

traditions.WLC: וַ֠ יָּבֹאוּ כָּל זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶל הַ מֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָ ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦλθον πάντες πρεσβύτεροι Ἰσραὴλ πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα εἰς Χεβρών ,
traditions.VUL: Venérunt ergo omnes maióres natu Israel ad regem in Hebron ,
traditions.KJV: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron ;

3.english_reference: and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּכְרֹת֩ לָ הֶ֨ם דָּוִ֥יד בְּרִ֛ית בְּ חֶבְר֖וֹן לִ פְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ διέθετο αὐτοῖς ὁ βασιλεὺς Δαυεὶδ διαθήκην ἐν Χεβρὼν ἐναντίον Κυρίου ,
traditions.VUL: et íniit David cum eis fœdus coram Dómino :
traditions.KJV: and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD ;

3.english_reference: and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the LORD by Samuel

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּמְשְׁח֨וּ אֶת דָּוִ֤יד לְ מֶ֨לֶךְ֙ עַל יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כִּ דְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה בְּ יַד שְׁמוּאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔχρισαν τὸν Δαυεὶδ εἰς βασιλέα ἐπὶ Ἰσραὴλ κατὰ τὸν λόγον Κυρίου διὰ χειρὸς Σαμουήλ .
traditions.VUL: unxerúntque eum regem super Israel , iuxta sermónem Dómini , quem locútus est in manu Sámuel .
traditions.KJV: and they anointed David king over Israel , according to the word of the LORD by Samuel .

4.english_reference: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֨לֶךְ דָּוִ֧יד וְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם הִ֣יא יְב֑וּס
traditions.LXX: Καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ ἄνδρες αὐτοῦ εἰς Ἰερουσαλήμ , αὕτη Ἰεβούς ,
traditions.VUL: Abiit quoque David , et omnis Israel in Ierúsalem : hæc est Iebus ,
traditions.KJV: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem , which [ is ] Jebus ;

4.english_reference: where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land

traditions.WLC: וְ שָׁם֙ הַ יְבוּסִ֔י יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָ אָֽרֶץ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκεῖ οἱ Ἰεβουσαῖοι οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν Ἰεβοὺς
traditions.KJV: where the Jebusites [ were ] , the inhabitants of the land .

5.english_reference: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ יֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְבוּס֙ לְ דָוִ֔יד לֹ֥א תָב֖וֹא הֵ֑נָּה
traditions.LXX: εἶπαν τῷ Δαυεὶδ Οὐκ εἰσελεύσῃ ὧδε .
traditions.VUL: Dixerúntque qui habitábant in Iebus ad David : Non ingrediéris huc .
traditions.KJV: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David , Thou shalt not come hither .

5.english_reference: Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּלְכֹּ֤ד דָּוִיד֙ אֶת מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֔וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד
traditions.LXX: καὶ προκατελάβετο τὴν περιοχὴν Σειών , αὕτη ἡ πόλις Δαυείδ .
traditions.VUL: Porro David cepit arcem Sion , quæ est cívitas David ,
traditions.KJV: Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion , which [ is ] the city of David .

6.english_reference: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain

traditions.WLC: וַ יֹּ֣אמֶר דָּוִ֔יד כָּל מַכֵּ֤ה יְבוּסִי֙ בָּ רִ֣אשׁוֹנָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֥ה לְ רֹ֖אשׁ וּ לְ שָׂ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπεν Δαυεὶδ Πᾶς τύπτων Ἰεβουσαῖον ἐν πρώτοις , καὶ ἔσται εἰς ἄρχοντα καὶ εἰς στρατηγόν ·
traditions.VUL: dixítque : Omnis qui percússerit Iebusǽum in primis , erit princeps et dux .
traditions.KJV: And David said , Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain .

6.english_reference: So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּ֧עַל בָּ רִאשׁוֹנָ֛ה יוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן צְרוּיָ֖ה וַ יְהִ֥י לְ רֹֽאשׁ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἀνέβη ἐπ᾽ αὐτῇ ἐν πρώτοις Ἰωὰβ υἱὸς Σαρουιά , καὶ ἐγένετο εἰς ἄρχοντα .
traditions.VUL: Ascéndit ígitur primus Ioab fílius Sárviæ , et factus est princeps .
traditions.KJV: So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up , and was chief .

7.english_reference: And David dwelt in the castle

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֥שֶׁב דָּוִ֖יד בַּ מְצָ֑ד
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐκάθισεν Δαυεὶδ ἐν τῇ περιοχῇ ·
traditions.KJV: And David dwelt in the castle ;

7.english_reference: therefore they called it the city of David

traditions.WLC: עַל כֵּ֥ן קָרְאוּ ל֖ וֹ עִ֥יר דָּוִֽיד
traditions.LXX: διὰ τοῦτο ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὴν Πόλιν Δαυείδ ·
traditions.VUL: et idcírco appelláta est cívitas David .
traditions.KJV: therefore they called it the city of David .

8.english_reference: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּ֤בֶן הָ עִיר֙ מִ סָּבִ֔יב מִן הַ מִּלּ֖וֹא וְ עַד הַ סָּבִ֑יב
traditions.LXX: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν πόλιν κύκλῳ ·
traditions.VUL: Ædificavítque urbem in circúitu a Mello usque ad gyrum :
traditions.KJV: And he built the city round about , even from Millo round about :

8.english_reference: and Joab repaired the rest of the city

traditions.WLC: וְ יוֹאָ֕ב יְחַיֶּ֖ה אֶת שְׁאָ֥ר הָ עִֽיר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπολέμησεν καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν πόλιν .
traditions.KJV: and Joab repaired the rest of the city .

9.english_reference: So David waxed greater and greater

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖יד הָל֣וֹךְ וְ גָד֑וֹל
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπορεύετο Δαυεὶδ πορευόμενος ,
traditions.KJV: So David waxed greater and greater :

9.english_reference: for the LORD of hosts was with him

traditions.WLC: וַ יהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ Κύριος Παντοκράτωρ μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et Dóminus exercítuum erat cum eo .
traditions.KJV: for the LORD of hosts [ was ] with him .

10.english_reference: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֨לֶּה רָאשֵׁ֤י הַ גִּבּוֹרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ דָוִ֔יד הַ מִּתְחַזְּקִ֨ים עִמּ֧ וֹ בְ מַלְכוּת֛ וֹ עִם כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְ הַמְלִיכ֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν δυνατῶν οἳ ἦσαν τῷ Δαυείδ , οἱ κατισχύοντες μετ᾽ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ αὐτοῦ μετὰ παντὸς Ἰσραὴλ τοῦ βασιλεῦσαι αὐτὸν
traditions.VUL: Hi príncipes virórum fórtium David , qui adiuvérunt eum ut rex fíeret super omnem Israel ,
traditions.KJV: These also [ are ] the chief of the mighty men whom David had , who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom , [ and ] with all Israel , to make him king ,

10.english_reference: according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel

traditions.WLC: כִּ דְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה עַל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.LXX: κατὰ τὸν λόγον Κυρίου ἐπὶ Ἰσραήλ .
traditions.VUL: iuxta verbum Dómini , quod locútus est ad Israel .
traditions.KJV: according to the word of the LORD concerning Israel .

11.english_reference: And this [ is ] the number of the mighty men whom David had

traditions.WLC: וְ אֵ֛לֶּה מִסְפַּ֥ר הַ גִּבֹּרִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְ דָוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὗτος ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν δυνατῶν τοῦ Δαυείδ ·
traditions.KJV: And this [ is ] the number of the mighty men whom David had ;

11.english_reference: Jashobeam , an Hachmonite , the chief of the captains

traditions.WLC: יָשָׁבְעָ֣ם בֶּן חַכְמוֹנִ֗י רֹ֚אשׁ ה שלושים
traditions.LXX: Ἰεσεβαδὰ υἱὸς Ἁχαμανεὶ πρῶτος τῶν τριάκοντα ·
traditions.VUL: Iésbaam fílius Hachamóni princeps inter trigínta :
traditions.KJV: Jashobeam , an Hachmonite , the chief of the captains :

11.english_reference: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain [ by him ] at one time .

traditions.WLC: הֽוּא עוֹרֵ֧ר אֶת חֲנִית֛ וֹ עַל שְׁלֹשׁ מֵא֥וֹת חָלָ֖ל בְּ פַ֥עַם אֶחָֽת
traditions.LXX: οὗτος ἐσπάσατο τὴν ῥομφαίαν αὐτοῦ ἅπαξ ἐπὶ τριακοσίους τραυματίας ἐν καιρῷ ἑνί .
traditions.VUL: iste levávit hastam suam super trecéntos vulnerátos una vice .
traditions.KJV: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain [ by him ] at one time .

12.english_reference: And after him [ was ] Eleazar the son of Dodo , the Ahohite

traditions.WLC: וְ אַחֲרָ֛י ו אֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּן דּוֹד֖וֹ הָ אֲחוֹחִ֑י
traditions.LXX: καὶ μετ᾽ αὐτὸν Ἐλεαζὰρ υἱὸς Δωδαὶ ὁ Ἀρχωνεί ,
traditions.VUL: Et post eum Eleázar fílius pátrui eius Ahohítes ,
traditions.KJV: And after him [ was ] Eleazar the son of Dodo , the Ahohite ,

12.english_reference: who [ was one ] of the three mighties .

traditions.WLC: ה֖וּא בִּ שְׁלוֹשָׁ֥ה הַ גִּבֹּרִֽים
traditions.LXX: οὗτος ἦν ἐν τοῖς τρισιν δυνατοῖς .
traditions.KJV: who [ was one ] of the three mighties .

13.english_reference: He was with David at Pasdammim

traditions.WLC: הֽוּא הָיָ֨ה עִם דָּוִ֜יד בַּ פַּ֣ס דַּמִּ֗ים
traditions.LXX: οὗτος ἦν μετὰ Δαυεὶδ ἐν Φασοδομή ,
traditions.VUL: Iste fuit cum David in Phésdomim ,
traditions.KJV: He was with David at Pasdammim ,

13.english_reference: and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle

traditions.WLC: וְ הַ פְּלִשְׁתִּים֙ נֶאֱסְפוּ שָׁ֣ם לַ מִּלְחָמָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ ἀλλόφυλοι συνήχθησαν ἐκεῖ εἰς πόλεμον ,
traditions.VUL: quando Philísthiim congregáti sunt ad locum illum in prœ́lium :
traditions.KJV: and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle ,

13.english_reference: where was a parcel of ground full of barley

traditions.WLC: וַ תְּהִ֛י חֶלְקַ֥ת הַ שָּׂדֶ֖ה מְלֵאָ֣ה שְׂעוֹרִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἦν μερὶς τοῦ ἀγροῦ πλήρης κριθῶν ,
traditions.VUL: et erat ager regiónis illíus plenus hórdeo ,
traditions.KJV: where was a parcel of ground full of barley ;

13.english_reference: and the people fled from before the Philistines .

traditions.WLC: וְ הָ עָ֥ם נָ֖סוּ מִ פְּנֵ֥י פְלִשְׁתִּֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ὁ λαὸς ἔφυγεν ἀπὸ προσώπου ἀλλοφύλων .
traditions.KJV: and the people fled from before the Philistines .

14.english_reference: And they set themselves in the midst of [ that ] parcel , and delivered it

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּֽתְיַצְּב֤וּ בְ תוֹךְ הַ חֶלְקָה֙ וַ יַּצִּיל֔וּ הָ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔστη ἐν μέσῳ τῆς μερίδος καὶ ἔσωσεν αὐτήν ,
traditions.VUL: Hi stetérunt in médio agri , et defendérunt eum :
traditions.KJV: And they set themselves in the midst of [ that ] parcel , and delivered it ,

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּכּ֖וּ אֶת פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπάταξεν τοὺς ἀλλοφύλους ·
traditions.KJV: and slew the Philistines ;

14.english_reference: and the LORD saved [ them ] by a great deliverance .

traditions.WLC: וַ יּ֥וֹשַׁע יְהוָ֖ה תְּשׁוּעָ֥ה גְדוֹלָֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐποίησεν Κύριος σωτηρίαν μεγάλην .
traditions.VUL: dedit Dóminus salútem magnam pópulo suo .
traditions.KJV: and the LORD saved [ them ] by a great deliverance .

15.english_reference: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David , into the cave of Adullam

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּרְד֡וּ שְֽׁלוֹשָׁה֩ מִן הַ שְּׁלוֹשִׁ֨ים רֹ֤אשׁ עַל הַ צֻּר֙ אֶל דָּוִ֔יד אֶל מְעָרַ֖ת עֲדֻלָּ֑ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ κατέβησαν τρεῖς ἐκ τῶν τριάκοντα ἀρχόντων εἰς τὴν πέτραν πρὸς Δαυεὶδ εἰς τὸ σπήλαιον Ὀδολλάμ ,
traditions.VUL: Descendérunt autem tres de trigínta princípibus ad petram , in qua erat David , ad spelúncam Odóllam ,
traditions.KJV: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David , into the cave of Adullam ;

15.english_reference: and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim .

traditions.WLC: וּ מַחֲנֵ֣ה פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים חֹנָ֖ה בְּ עֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ παρεμβολὴ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι τῶν γιγάντων .
traditions.VUL: quando Philísthiim fúerant castrametáti in valle Ráphaim .
traditions.KJV: and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim .

16.english_reference: And David [ was ] then in the hold

traditions.WLC: וְ דָוִ֖יד אָ֣ז בַּ מְּצוּדָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ Δαυεὶδ τότε ἐν τῇ περιοχῇ ,
traditions.KJV: And David [ was ] then in the hold ,

16.english_reference: and the Philistines ’ garrison [ was ] then at Bethlehem .

traditions.WLC: וּ נְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אָ֖ז בְּ בֵ֥ית לָֽחֶם
traditions.LXX: καὶ τὸ σύστεμα τῶν ἀλλοφύλων τότε ἐν Βαιθλέεμ .
traditions.KJV: and the Philistines ’ garrison [ was ] then at Bethlehem .

traditions.WLC: ו יתאו דָּוִ֖יד וַ יֹּאמַ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἐπεθύμησεν Δαυεὶδ καὶ εἶπεν
traditions.KJV: And David longed , and said ,
